content: Sungsang Thianthona
Tuazawkciang Jerusalem pan in, Pharisee te le thukhamhil te Jesus kungah hongpai uh a,
Banghangin na nungzui te in ka pu le pa ngeina te paltan ziam? Banghangziam cile amate in an a neak tu uh ciang a khut uh sil ngawl hi, ci hi.
Ahihang Jesus in,

content.text: Banghang in Pathian thupiak te sia na pu le pa ngeina taw paltan nu ziam?
Banghangziam cile, Pathian in thupia a, na nu le na pa zakta in: a nu le a pa a taisan peuma ki that tu hi, ci hi.
Ahihang note in, khatpo in a nu a hibale a pa a piak tu khatpo sia, Pathian atu a kipia sa hi, ci a hi po le,
A nu a hibale a pa sia upat kul nawn ngawl, peng thei hi, ci nu hi. Tabang in note in na pu le pa ngeina zang in Pathian thupiak sia mannei ngawl sua nu hi.
No a ki hitheamsak te, kamsang Isaiah in noma thu a mantak in a sonkhol na ah,
Hi mite in a kam bek uh taw kei hong neak a, a muk bek taw kei hong upat uh hi; ahihang a thinsung uh sia kei taw ki khuala hi, ci hi.
Ahihang mihing te thupiakna bang in pomdan te hil a, keima hong biak sia luithathong bek hi,

content: ci in zo kik hi.
Taciang Jesus in mihonpi te sam a,

content.text: Ngai vun a, he tavun.
Kamsung pan a tum te in mihing ninsak ngawl a, kam sung pan a a pusuak te in mihing ninsak zaw hi,

content: ci hi.
Tasiaciang a nungzui te a kungah hongpai a, na thuson te in Pharisee te thin-uksak hi, ci na he ziam? ci uh hi.
Jesus in,

content.text: Vantung a om Ka Pa i suan ngawl peuma ki bot siat tu hi.
Koi lel vun: amate sia mittaw te lamlak mittaw te hi. Mittaw in mittaw lamlak le a ni in luamsung ah tak tu hi,

content: ci in zo kik hi.
Peter in tua thu sontena hong son thiang tan, ci ngen hi.
Jesus in,

content.text: Note zong tu dong telthiam ngawl lai nu ziam?
Kamsung a tumsuk te theampo sia ngilpi sungah theng a, taciang dumsung ah vawk hi, ci tu dong tel thei ngawl lai nu ziam?
Ahihang kamsung pan a pusuakte sia thinsung pan pusuak ahikom; tua te in mihing sia ninsak hi.
Banghangziam cile, ngaisutna phangawl, tual that, palngul mawna, paktat na, nguta, a man ngawl tetti, sonsiatna te theampo sia thinsung pan in a pusuak a hihi:
Hite in mihing ninsak hi: hi kale khut sil ngawl anneakna in mihing ninsak ngawl hi,

content: ci hi.
Canaan Numeinu Upna
Jesus tua mun pan pai a, Tyre le Sidon khua kiim teng ah pai hi.
Tua khua kiim ah a teang Canaan numei khat a kungah hongpai a, Maw Topa, nang David Tapa awng, hong hesuak ka po in, ka tanu sia doai in nasiatak in vawtsia hi, ci in au hi.
Ahihang Jesus in kamkhat zong zo kik ngawl hi. A nungzui te hongpai in, hi numei sia not in, banghangziam cile i nung pan in au top hi, ci ngen hi.
Ahihang Jesus in,

content.text: Israel minam sung pan tuu pai te kung simngawl hong ki sawl ngawl hi,

content: ci in zo kik hi.
Tasiaciang tua nu hongpai in, Jesus bia a, Topa awng, hong hu tan, ci hi.
Jesus in ama zo kik a,

content.text: Tate i anneak laksak in ui piak tu sia ngeina om ngawl hi,

content: ci hi.
Numei nu in, man hi, Topa awng: hima kale, to te i sabuai pan anneng tak te buang ui in ne hi, ci hi.
Tasiazawkciang Jesus in zo kik a,

content.text: Maw numei nu, na upna lian mama hi: na deina bang in hi tahen,

content: ci hi. Tua hun lian in a tanu damthiang hi.
Jesus in Mi Tam Mama Damsak
Jesus tua mun nusia in, Galilee tuili hui ah pai in; mualtung ah kato hi.
Mihon tampi te a kungah hongpai a, amate taw peangbai, mittaw, pau thei ngawl, pumpi cing ngawl le a dang tampi te hong paipui a, Jesus peang ah koi tek uh hi; Jesus in amate damsak hi:
A pau thei ngawl te pau thei, pumpi kim ngawl te dam, peangbai te lampai, mittaw te in khuamu ci mihonpi in a mu uh ciang in lamdangsa tek mama a: Israel te Pathian pok uh hi.
Mihing Tulli Anvak
Jesus in a nungzui te sam a,

content.text: Hi mihonpi te tungah hesuakna nei khi hi, banghangziam cile ka kungah nithum sung a kipe in om zo uh a, neak tu bangma nei ngawl hi: amate lamkal ah puk-hong in a tha bo tu ahiciang, an ngawl in ciasak ngawl tu khi hi,

content: ci hi.
Nungzui te in, mihon tampi te a kham in vak natu an tampi hi duisung ah koisung pan om tu ziam? ci uh hi.
Jesus in,

content.text: Anluum bangza nei nu ziam?

content: ci in dong hi. Amate in anluum sali le ngasa nosi tawm, ci uh hi.
Tasiaciang Jesus in mihonpi te lei ah to tu in thupia hi.
Anluum sali le ngasa tawm teng la in, lungdam a ko zawkciang khen in a nungzui te kungah pia hi, a nungzui te in mihonpi te pia hi.
A vekpi a khamteak in ne tek uh hi: tuazawkciang a bal nen sa a val teng a top uh ciang bawm sali dim hi.
A nete sia numei le patang ki simngawl pasal tul li pha hi.
Jesus in mihonpi te ciasak a, ama sia ngunkuang sungah to in Magdala khua kiim ah theng hi.
